content.text: This warranty package meets or exceeds our preferred position on every element.

input.quote: 19.4 For breach of Section 19.1 or 19.2, Vendor shall promptly re-perform, repair, or replace the nonconforming item at no charge. If Vendor cannot do so within a reasonable period, Customer may terminate the affected item and receive a refund of Fees paid for it. This remedy is not exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security, or indemnified claims.
input.rationale: Section 19 satisfies each element of the preferred position. Section 19.1 gives a professional and workmanlike services warranty by qualified personnel in accordance with industry standards, plus a material conformity warranty for Services and Deliverables. Section 19.2 provides the 90-day Deliverable conformity period running from delivery or acceptance, whichever is later (better than delivery-only), and Hosted Services must conform throughout the subscription term, which exceeds the 12-month software benchmark for the hosted scope. Section 19.3 covers no malicious code and compliance with Applicable Law, and adds no-functionality-diminishment and open-source protections. Section 19.4 supplies the full repair/replace/re-perform remedy with a termination-and-refund backstop, and expressly states the remedy is not exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security, or indemnified claims, so the "sole remedy" narrowing we resist is absent. Section 19.5 limits the disclaimer to implied warranties only, is mutual, and expressly provides that no disclaimer limits an express warranty, service level, indemnity, or remedy, so the disclaimer does not swallow the express warranty. No "AS IS" or sole-remedy language appears anywhere in the document, and Sections 3.1 and 6 reinforce rather than undercut the warranty. No redline needed.
